title: Geopolitical Events: What Mutual Fund Investors Should Do

faq.q: Should I invest in defence mutual funds now that they are performing well?
faq.a: Chasing recent performance is generally not advisable. Sectoral funds are highly concentrated and carry higher risk. It's often better to stick to diversified funds that spread risk across various sectors.

faq.q: Is it wise to pull money out of IT funds due to their recent decline?
faq.a: Selling during a downturn locks in losses. If your investment in IT funds aligns with your long-term strategy and risk tolerance, it's often better to stay invested, especially if you are using SIPs, which benefit from lower prices.

faq.q: How do SIPs help during market volatility?
faq.a: SIPs enable rupee cost averaging. When markets fall, your fixed investment buys more units, and when they rise, it buys fewer. Over time, this averages your purchase cost and can lead to better returns.

faq.q: What is the role of diversification in my mutual fund portfolio?
faq.a: Diversification spreads your investments across different asset classes, market caps, and sectors. This reduces overall portfolio risk, as the underperformance of one segment can be offset by the better performance of others.

faq.q: Should geopolitical events change my long-term financial plan?
faq.a: Major geopolitical events are part of the market cycle. While they can cause short-term volatility, they typically should not alter a well-thought-out long-term financial plan. Focus on your goals and stay disciplined.

faq.q: Where can I find reliable information on mutual fund performance?
faq.a: You can find reliable information on mutual fund performance, Net Asset Values (NAVs), and other data on the AMFI India website or directly from the respective Asset Management Company (AMC) websites.

faq.q: Are there any tax implications if I frequently switch between mutual funds?
faq.a: Yes, frequent switching can lead to short-term or long-term capital gains tax, depending on the holding period and type of fund. It can also incur exit loads. It's important to understand these implications before making changes.
